THE 5-LEAD PILOT

Start small.
See what’s possible.

A focused first campaign built around five relevant enquiries. Explore lead generation for your business before discussing a wider programme.

  1. Agree what a good lead looks like.
    Your service, location and qualifying criteria.
  2. Connect the campaign and follow-up.
    A clear next step for each new enquiry.
  3. Review your first five together.
    Understand lead quality and decide what comes next.

Scope, pricing, advertising budget and timing are agreed before launch. A lead is an enquiry, not a guaranteed booking or sale.

A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT BE WONDERING

Good questions.
Straight answers.

Do I need all of your services?+

No. We start with the problem you want to solve. That could be lead generation, follow-up, review collection, or one custom AI integration. We agree a scope that makes sense for your business.

What does it cost?+

Pricing depends on the campaigns, tools and integrations involved. We provide a clear proposal before work begins. Advertising spend is separate from our service fee and paid directly to the advertising platform.

Can you work with my existing tools?+

We review your CRM, calendar and other tools first. Where supported, we connect them into your workflow. Limitations, third-party costs and changes are discussed before we build.

Does AI replace the personal touch?+

It should support it. Automation handles routine steps and initial follow-up, while your team stays in control of important conversations and decisions.

How does the 5-lead pilot work?+

We start by agreeing your target customer, area and what counts as a relevant enquiry. Then we scope a campaign around your first five leads. Pricing, advertising spend and timing are agreed before launch. Leads are enquiries, rather than guaranteed appointments or customers.
